jess: Heads-up — console is showing a weird per-tenant quota spike for several customers after yesterday's SDK releases. Not a real usage surge. Investigating now.

matt: Which SDKs shipped? Python/TS/Go?

jess: Python 3.2.0 and TS 2.8.1 were rolled late-afternoon. Go didn't change.

li: Any pattern in the requests? same endpoint, same route header?

jess: Looks like attribution is dropping to 'unknown' for a subset. Query shows many requests missing the legacy `x-rw-tenant` header, but they carry `X-Cost-Center`. Console mapping hasn't caught that, so the UI lumps them together and quota math is off.

sam: We changed header normalization in TS SDK to canonicalize header names to lowercase in 2.8.1 to satisfy proxy rules. That might hide `x-rw-tenant` vs `X-RW-Tenant` differences from the console's exact-match mapping.

jess: Agreed. Also noticed Python 3.2.0 introduced an automatic metadata passthrough shim that conditionally strips empty headers on retry, and in some retry cases the header is entirely dropped.

akshay: Ugh. Two separate compat issues causing the same symptom. Options: (1) Console: add header aliasing/fallback mapping (e.g., check Cost-Center then x-rw-tenant then lowercased variants) — fast fix for dash math. (2) SDK: ship small patch to preserve header casing/keys and avoid dropping on retry. (3) Telemetry: mark affected events as 'attribution:unknown' so alerts ignore them.
matt: Which is least risky to ship quickly?

jess: Console aliasing is fastest and reversible. I can open a small PR for mapping logic and a migration flag. Will need a console deploy window.

li: For SDKs, we should avoid breaking header consumers. Proposal: TS patch to stop lowercasing header keys (2.8.2) and Python patch to stop dropping non-empty headers on retry (3.2.1). Both are tiny changes but need release + rollout.

sam: I can cut the TS patch now. Going to keep normalization but add an opt-out that preserves original header key if present. Will target a canary publish to npm with tag `canary-attrfix`.

ajess-notes: (typo) ignore

akshay: Can we change console alerting to ignore counts from requests that have been tagged with the new `attribution:unknown` flag for 48h to avoid noisy pager?

jess: Yes — I'll add an alert-suppression rule tied to that tag.

deploy-bot: canary-console-deploy: started deployment to staging cluster at 4109876600 :rocket:

matt: Timeline? If console patch goes to staging today we can fix UI math for customers tomorrow morning. SDK patches can follow and retroactively improve attribution.

jess: Plan agreed. Action items: 1) jess — console alias/fallback PR + alert suppression (staging -> prod rollout tomorrow AM). 2) sam — TS canary publish and PR for 2.8.2. 3) li — quick Python patch PR for 3.2.1 to keep headers intact. 4) akshay — confirm metrics pipeline can backfill remapped attributions for last 6h if SDK patches land.

sam: starting TS patch now, will ping when canary available. :white_check_mark:

li: Python PR coming in ~30m.

jess: Thanks all — will follow up in #customer-success with a short note and ETA once staging looks good. :thumbsup:
